memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Glaucoma.
Evidence: Intraocular pressure 28 mmHg OU, visual field shows paracentral scotoma, optic disc cupping ratio 0.7. Patient denies eye pain or redness. No respiratory symptoms. Smoking status: never. No inhaler prescribed; technique not applicable.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: timolol 0.5% eye drops, one drop each eye twice daily.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Intraocular pressure: Right eye 28 mmHg (reference 10-21), Left eye 27 mmHg (reference 10-21).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Glaucoma.
Evidence: IOP reduced to 22 mmHg OU after timolol; visual field stable; optic disc unchanged. Patient reports mild ocular irritation with timolol. Smoking status: never. Inhaler technique not applicable.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Add latanoprost 0.005% eye drops, one drop each eye at bedtime. Continue timolol BD.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Intraocular pressure: Right eye 22 mmHg, Left eye 21 mmHg.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Glaucoma.
Evidence: IOP 18 mmHg OU on dual therapy; visual field shows no progression; optic disc cupping ratio 0.65. Patient tolerates drops well. Smoking status: never. Inhaler technique not applicable.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Intraocular pressure: Right eye 18 mmHg, Left eye 17 mmHg.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I have been feeling a gritty sensation in my eyes, especially in the mornings, since starting the eye drops. It improves with artificial tears but returns later.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Glaucoma.
Evidence: IOP 19 mmHg OU; visual field stable; optic disc unchanged. Patient reports gritty sensation, likely preservative-related irritation from timolol. Smoking status: never. Inhaler technique not applicable.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Change timolol to preservative-free formulation 0.5% eye drops, one drop each eye twice daily. Continue latanoprost HS.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Intraocular pressure: Right eye 19 mmHg, Left eye 18 mmHg.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Glaucoma.
Evidence: IOP 18 mmHg OU; visual field shows no change; optic disc cupping ratio 0.6. Patient reports ocular comfort improved with preservative-free timolol. Smoking status: never. Inhaler technique not applicable.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Intraocular pressure: Right eye 18 mmHg, Left eye 17 mmHg.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Booked follow-up glaucoma review for 2026-07-10 at 10:00 with Dr Suresh Menon.

memories.text:
Glaucoma.
Evidence: IOP 17 mmHg OU; visual field stable; optic disc unchanged. Patient adherent to preservative-free timolol BD and latanoprost HS. Smoking status: never. Inhaler technique not applicable.

memories.text: Intraocular pressure: Right eye 17 mmHg, Left eye 16 mmHg.
